sloka: कर्मभिस्तु शुभैरिष्टै: क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणै: ।स्वर्गं दशरथ: प्राप्त: पिता न: पृथिवीपति: ॥ २.१०५.३४॥
transliteration: karmabhistu śubhairiṣṭai: kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇai: ।svargaṁ daśaratha: prāpta: pitā na: pṛthivīpati: ॥ 2.105.34॥

translations.english: Dasaratha, our father and lord of the earth, reached heaven by performing auspicious acts and offering abundant charities in sacrifices.
